subject: [PATCH v4 05/21] xfs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

reviews.author: Darrick Wong
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch is a 'straightforward conversion' and approved it, giving a Reviewed-by tag.
reviews.raw_body:
Nice straightforward conversion! :)
Reviewed-by: "Darrick J. Wong" <djwong@kernel.org>

--D

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the XFS iomap operations to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next() helper. The conversion does not introduce any functional changes and is a step towards adopting the new callback interface. The patch updates several functions in xfs_iomap.c and xfs_file.c to use the new callback, including xfs_direct_write_iomap_ops, xfs_zoned_direct_write_iomap_ops, and xfs_atomic_write_cow_iomap_ops.
